I see some people are taking Object Icon seriously. I have not looked at any pushes or reports you may have made.

It is a lot for me to handle. But I am loathe to set up a team, either. I would have to trust the people involved to write code the way I like it done, and very, VERY few people could do that.

I have made a few of my own changes to the autotooling.

The way I would want code is EITHER TOTALLY STRUCTURED OR FUNCTIONAL. With modified McCabe or branching respectively<=10
